headline: Vitafoam Nigeria Reports 47% Profit Surge to N21.3 Billion
summary: Vitafoam Nigeria Plc reported a 46.6 percent increase in group profit after tax to N21.31 billion, driven by cost efficiency.
why: Vitafoam Nigeria is a major manufacturer of foam and polyurethane products, listed on the Nigerian Exchange, making its earnings a key indicator of domestic consumer goods demand and manufacturing margins in West Africa.

impacts.name: Vitafoam Nigeria
impacts.why: Strong profit growth directly reflects improved financial performance for the company.
